prompt: In trip-planner/, let the agent ask our hotels agent about room availability. The hotels agent is another graph-agents-cli agent: it serves A2A at /a2a/hotels, and its URL goes in HOTELS_AGENT_URL. The agent may send it questions and check on their status, but it must never approve anything at the hotels agent for the user: people approve their bookings there themselves.

checks.expr: any(isinstance(a, dict) and a.get('protocol') == 'a2a' and get(a, 'a2a.path') == '/a2a/hotels' and a.get('base_url_env') == 'HOTELS_AGENT_URL' and a.get('auth') == 'exchange' and bool(get(a, 'exchange.audience')) for a in (get(data, 'apis') or {}).values())
checks.why: another agent is a protocol: a2a API at its A2A endpoint, reached for the user with a token exchanged for theirs (`graph-agents-cli peer add`)

checks.expr: any(isinstance(a, dict) and get(a, 'a2a.path') == '/a2a/hotels' and any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get('a2a_operation') == 'approve' for d in (a.get('denied_operations') or [])) for a in (get(data, 'apis') or {}).values())
checks.why: messages that approve the peer's pending approvals are denied (`peer add --approvals deny`), not relayed through a gate here

checks.expr: any(isinstance(a, dict) and get(a, 'a2a.path') == '/a2a/hotels' and {'SendMessage', 'GetTask'} <= {o.get('rpc_method') for o in (a.get('allowed_operations') or []) if isinstance(o, dict)} for a in (get(data, 'apis') or {}).values())
checks.why: the agent may send the peer messages (SendMessage) and read their tasks (GetTask)
`peer add` generates tools/a2a_peers.py (ask_agent) from the policy
never hand-write A2A client code: the generated module and the template's a2a_client call the peer through the policy
the template's A2A client (app_utils/a2a_client.py) is used as it is, never edited

reference: `graph-agents-cli peer add hotels --approvals deny --description "..."` (with --dry-run first): the API hotels_agent (protocol a2a, a2a.path /a2a/hotels, base_url_env HOTELS_AGENT_URL, auth exchange for audience hotels under the jwt policy), SendMessage and GetTask allowed, and messages that approve the hotels agent's pending approvals denied (denied_operations: a2a_operation approve) instead of relayed; tools/a2a_peers.py generated. No hand-written A2A client code. `lint` passes. Report what peer add leaves to set (HOTELS_AGENT_URL, the token-exchange settings, AUTH_ALLOWED_ACTORS on the hotels agent).
